Hymn 34: O Ye Mountains High
Time Signature: 3/4
Musical Key: C Major
Composer: Charles W. Denison

Category: Praise to the Lord

This is hymn number 34 titled "O Ye Mountains High" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in C Major with a 3/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Charles W. Denison and the lyrics were written by Charles W. Penrose.
This hymn is categorized under: Praise to the Lord.
